comparison.objective: Commission a fixed damper setting through repeated carriage tests vs continuously aim a camera at an unpredictably moving person and react to a cue.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool/collar manipulation and discrete iterative tuning vs continuous bar-mediated tracking plus rapid bimanual button response.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe impact cycles within mechanical limits vs keep the target framed and press the remote button within 1 second of the lamp cue without losing aim.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop tracking and cue reaction test a fundamentally different real-time ability from mechanical adjustment and retained-setting validation. Exact framing tolerances are missing from the record.
